name: Tonight board
summary: Tonight's campus events, gathered from the group's scattered posts, up on a theater marquee with chasing bulbs: each line has its start time, where it is and the walk, a row of heat bulbs by how many starred it, and the faces of friends going; tap a line to star it and your face joins the crowd under it.
useWhen: so many event posts, which ones are tonight
dontUseWhen: planning one specific event (use an event page or squad-lock)
picking a weekend weeks away (use clear-skies)
a party at someone's place (use party-headcount)

sub.description: Line under the title: the group and where the events came from

sign.description: Header painted on the marquee, e.g. 'Tonight in Eastfield'

events.description: 1 to 6 events tonight, in time order

stars.description: Stars from the group so far

said.description: A line from the post about it
